authorInfo.bio: James Edward Austen-Leigh (1798–1874) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Memoir of Jane Austen" by James Edward Austen-Leigh is a biography published in 1869. Written by Austen's nephew with help from family members, this Victorian-era memoir introduced the wider public to Jane Austen's works for the first time.
